verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that indexes the Mesh guides. Doc pages are served as raw Markdown, with frontmatter declaring `agentTools.projectIndex` pointing back to that llms.txt. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is also retrievable without authentication, so an agent can be pointed at structured, agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
